description: Soutirages quotidiens provisoires sur le réseau de transport d'électricité par section d'activité (2020 à 2026) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). ATTENTION: les données du 1er mai 2022 au 26 juin 2025 sont surestimées. Les valeurs corrigées sont disponibles dans le jeu de données « consolidées ». Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation. The portal shows 2022-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
